original_method: Certify end-to-end Gen6 support and pin Speed Change 56; for each cycle establish full-width Gen5, request Gen6, capture equalization/LTSSM and settled width with error/health deltas, stop before the next cycle on any unsupported, incomplete, or failed result, and recover out of band.

500-count, abort, final-state, artifact-integrity, and recovery policy
safety_requirements: No execution or forcing without positive Gen6 support
Dedicated SUT with stable power/cooling and out-of-band console

Fail closed before the next cycle

Review all 500 results and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

review_improvement: Adds explicit high-generation capability and Gen5-start gates without weakening the source's Gen6 target or repetition requirement.
independent_technical_reasoning: The transition begins at Gen5, so both the initial and target states already depend on a high-margin channel. A nominal target value cannot show that the link truly began at full-width Gen5 or completed Gen6 equalization without recovery loops and corrected errors. Every count must therefore bind start, training, settle, width, and error delta before the next request. Unsupported capability means BLOCKED execution, not permission to force or downgrade.
